original_ai_output.title_zh: 西班牙国王访问休达，寻求与摩洛哥保持“睦邻关系”
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 西班牙国王费利佩六世访问休达期间呼吁与摩洛哥保持“睦邻关系”，并重申西班牙对休达和梅利利亚的主权不可谈判。此次访问正值两国因移民问题关系紧张之际。数月前，超过7万名移民涌入休达，造成人员死亡，数千人滞留当地，条件恶劣。

key_facts.fact: 西班牙国王费利佩六世访问休达，呼吁与摩洛哥保持睦邻关系
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Spain’s King Felipe VI has called for “good neighbourly relations” with Morocco during a landmark visit to Ceuta

key_facts.fact: 西班牙重申对休达和梅利利亚的主权不可谈判
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the king reaffirmed Spain’s sovereignty over Ceuta and Melilla, two Spanish-administered territories in North Africa claimed by Morocco. He said their status was not negotiable

key_facts.fact: 数月前超过7万名移民涌入休达，造成人员死亡，数千人滞留
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: more than 70,000 migrants entered Ceuta on 30 and 31 July in an unprecedented influx. Scores died, most returned to Morocco in the following hours, but thousands have remained for weeks in often dire conditions
